checks.scope: Several template sections for a fact category are targeted.
checks.observable: Category equality is not equality of scoped operative facts.
checks.consistency: Distinct subjects need not share a home for their different risks.
checks.exceptions: Only distinct categories are exempt, missing distinct facts within one.
checks.fix: A global category map can collapse unrelated scoped registers.
checks.expression: Define same fact by subject, meaning and revision.

entries.rationale: Use semantic identity before requiring one canonical home.

checks.scope: Consuming-document input slots that restate another document are targeted.
checks.observable: The requested slot shape can contradict adjacent link-only prose.
checks.consistency: Consistent with AP-85's ownership rule; this is a narrower signal.
checks.exceptions: The consuming document's own decisions and outcomes are exempt.
checks.fix: Section links preserve traceability without a duplicate input summary.
checks.expression: The example explains why shape matters beyond a prose instruction.

entries.rationale: The entry gives a concrete template failure; ownership must be established at the source.

checks.scope: Workflow-boundary output-discipline verification is the intended subject.
checks.observable: Line budgets cannot decide semantic fact ownership or fidelity.
checks.consistency: Critical guarantees also need AP-79's failure-blocking behaviour.
checks.exceptions: A bound verifier is exempt but its effective check is unspecified.
checks.fix: Declare invariant-specific checks and an unresolved-failure outcome.
checks.expression: Gate is underspecified beside a blanket ban on control constructs.

entries.rationale: Verify the property itself and make failure affect completion.

checks.scope: Every artifact declaration is covered, beyond lifecycle state.
checks.observable: Audience-field presence is observable; format suitability needs a contract.
checks.consistency: A review link cannot supersede a machine consumer's format.
checks.exceptions: Non-artifacts are exempt; code and constrained data artifacts are not.
checks.fix: Human/prose and agent/JSON can prescribe incompatible serialization.
checks.expression: Separate who reads a file from the format its consumer requires.

entries.rationale: Retain audience declaration while honoring the artifact's explicit format contract.

checks.scope: User-presented durable artifact references are well specified.
checks.observable: An interpolated produced path is directly inspectable.
checks.consistency: Numeric-prefix assignment is unrelated to link correctness.
checks.exceptions: Chat-only subjects and internal diagnostics are appropriately excluded.
checks.fix: Link and persist correctly; leave naming to the producing contract.
checks.expression: The numeric-prefix sentence adds an unrelated naming policy.

entries.rationale: The link rule is clear after removing the universal prefix assumption.

checks.scope: Checkpoint messages and option descriptions duplicating structure are targeted.
checks.observable: Duplicated timing is observable; actual notice delivery is not checked.
checks.consistency: Single authority must still deliver decision-relevant information.
checks.exceptions: Pure status is exempt, but channels lacking timing displays are absent.
checks.fix: Derive notice from structure where the UI does not render it.
checks.expression: Schema owns the fact does not imply the user received it.

entries.rationale: Make removal conditional on faithful user-facing rendering; no current-client defect is claimed.

checks.scope: Checkpoint message grammar is explicitly the subject.
checks.observable: Trailing questions and listed interrogative forms are inspectable.
checks.consistency: A statement plus decision options can implement DP-04 clarification.
checks.exceptions: Interpolated question marks not addressed to the user are exempt.
checks.fix: Rewrite the subject as a statement and keep choice in options.
checks.expression: This is a precise local style convention, not a general ban on questions.

entries.rationale: The grammatical rule is narrow and observable; it need not be broadened into a semantic conflict.

checks.scope: Design standards in runtime rules are targeted without authoring-run scope.
checks.observable: Writing workflows and cross-session reuse are insufficient discriminators.
checks.consistency: Authoring is itself runtime work for an authoring technique.
checks.exceptions: Current-output conformance obligations need a named exception.
checks.fix: Delete copied criteria, not the duty to apply their canonical home.
checks.expression: Differentiate criterion ownership from applying a criterion now.

entries.rationale: Clarify the boundary so legitimate authoring output invariants survive.
